title: Choose the visual world for Food Diary
question: Two directions. Pick one, re-roll, or take the familiar path.

options.label: The Night Ledger
options.lineage: cloth-bound visitor's book, ink date stamps, tipped-in prints
options.thesis: A private record of real visits, kept like a ledger and shown like prints.
options.viewport: A spine rail, a stamped date and dish, one large tipped-in photograph, and a numbered print strip.
options.risk: Stamp motifs can turn decorative if they repeat on every element.

raised.raise: One 1:1 detail call-out magnifies a real photo detail with a hairline leader.
Selecting a dish re-marks every matching entry across the diary at once.
A single hand-ink annotation on the photo carries the owner's voice.
A folded tape flag marks the last-viewed entry and survives navigation.
Dish identity tints a whole surface region, not a scattered accent.
Counts and dish labels are set at monumental scale, not as small meta text.

options.label: The Light Table
options.lineage: photographer's contact sheet laid on a matte light table
options.thesis: The photograph is the entry; the interface is only the frame number beside it.
options.viewport: One hero frame, a grease-pencil circle, a quiet caption column, and a numbered contact strip.
options.risk: A contact sheet is where most photography-led redesigns land; familiar, but effective.

options.label: Build Instructions
options.thesis: Each visit as a numbered assembly step.
options.viewport: Oversized step numbers and call-out boxes.
options.case: Reads as a tutorial, not one person's record of meals.

options.label: Folded Sheet
options.thesis: An index that unfolds into the full grid.
options.viewport: A compact packet opening into a tessellated field.
options.case: The fold asks for a gesture the visitor has no reason to learn.
options.kept: One control that propagates across the whole sheet.

options.label: Drawn Zine
options.thesis: A friend sketches the meal for you.
options.viewport: Doodled panels and a mascot guide.
options.case: A mascot invents a character the owner never wrote.
options.kept: One hand-ink annotation as the owner's mark.
options.risk: Cute where the brief asks for restraint.

options.label: Select Rail
options.thesis: Visits as punched frames on a selection rail.
options.viewport: A scrubbing rail with the current frame flagged.
options.case: Suggests an editing workflow this site does not have.
options.risk: Professional tool costume on a personal diary.

options.label: Copy-Shop Stock
options.thesis: One coloured stock per sheet, one typed column.
options.viewport: A single typed column on goldenrod stock.
options.case: Zine culture is not the visitor's frame of reference.
options.kept: Colour as the sheet, never the mark.

options.label: Wayfinding Bands
options.thesis: The map as a chain of decision bands.
options.viewport: Sticky yellow bands with monumental gate numbers.
options.case: Works for the map, fails for the diary.
options.kept: Monumental numerals for counts and dish labels.
options.risk: Too loud for a reading surface.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean dark photo grid with a sidebar map, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement visitors expect, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other food gallery by design.
